candidates.snippet: During the eleven years of government without parliament very little is recorded of Cromwell. His name is not connected with the resistance to the levy of ship-money or to the action of the ecclesiastical courts, but in 1630 he was one of those fined for refusing to take up knighthood. The same year he was named one of the justices of the peace for his borough;
candidates.why: Exact canonical-name match against 1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica entry.
